title: Schedule

execute:

---

All assignments are due by 11:59pm on the due date. Each week pairs a
**Concept** (the idea we learn) with a **Building** (the kind of thing we
make, which can span several weeks); the **Build** is that week's take-home
assignment. Quizzes are handwritten, given at the start of class, and cover the
week(s) listed. Dates are tentative and will be confirmed against the official
Fall 2027 academic calendar.

```{r}
# NOTE: The schedule.lua file is inserted as a filter in _quarto.yml to
# avoid the insertion of a <colgroup> in the html around this table:
# https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/issues/8139

source("_common.R")

schedule <- get_schedule()

done <- schedule %>%
  select(
    Week = week,
    Date = date_md,
    Quiz = quiz,
    Concept = class,
    Building = building,
    Build = assignments,
    Project = project
  ) %>%
  kable(
    format = 'html',
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c('c', 'c', 'l', 'l', 'l', 'l', 'l')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  column_spec(column = 1, width = '2em') %>%
  column_spec(column = 2, width = '3em') %>%
  column_spec(column = 4, width = '20em') %>%
  column_spec(column = 6, width = '12em')

done
```
